note: State park campground at the park headquarters on the edge of Idyllwild off Hwy 243, walkable to shops. Only 8 of the 28 sites take a 23-ft rig: the full-hookup sites 1, 2 and 26, the electric sites 4-6 and plain sites 8 and 33; the rest are tent sites or shorter pads. --Claude
